title: Mermaid pane: /diagram and show_diagram render art or SVG, with an HTML fallback (ODOC-494, DEC-221)
description: Queued under ODOC-494 (design: opum-doc DEC-221 at 7547fe9e, read by ref) and ODOC-497 (operator-approved, opum-doc#1133). Build the diagram-skills Mermaid pane: /diagram and mcp__diagram-skills__show_diagram draw art or SVG, with an HTML fallback. Copy plain-english-styles' renderer with its provenance SHA and its four licences; the licence becomes MIT AND EPL-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause. Build to the six ACs in opum-doc docs/research/market/evidence/2026-10-20-mods/ (to be read by ref and transcribed into this task before work starts). Scope stops at the merged PR: the v0.2.0 release and its pin move in opum-marketplace are DEC-182 floor work, arranged separately by Rev 288. Not started; follows profile-skills #9 and the proofs PR.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A file draws in the pane. /diagram docs/specs/foo.md opens a pane and draws the first closed mermaid fence: Unicode art on the terminal and Svg on desktop. Verified by mounting the pane on both surfaces with the same fixture and asserting the element type drawn.

Fallback works both ways. A gantt fence (unsupported) and a flowchart wider than bodyColumns both keep their source, show a one-line reason and an Open diagram Button; pressing it writes an HTML file with the vendored mermaid.js and no network references, and runs open on it. A supported, fitting flowchart draws instead and shows no Button.

The model can push a diagram. mcp__diagram-skills__show_diagram with {source, title, alt} draws that source in the same pane. A malformed source returns {ok:false, reason} and the pane keeps the previous drawing; it never draws a partial diagram.

Missing runtime is stated. With bun and node both absent from PATH, the pane shows the source and one line naming what is missing; no helper call is retried in a loop. The pane still opens, so the source is readable.

Limits hold. A source over 20,000 characters is not rendered and says why; more than 8 fences in one document draws 8 and states how many are hidden; an unsupported type and a render error are cached, so a redraw does not re-run the helper (verified by counting helper invocations).

The licence and packaging story is complete. The four licence files and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md ship in the plugin; plugin.json declares MIT AND EPL-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause; the provenance SHA of the copied renderer is recorded; claude plugin validate passes; the plugin loads and the command appears in the command list.

implementationNotes: Transcribed 2026-10-20 from the First build slice of opum-doc docs/research/market/evidence/2026-10-20-mods/pr-mod-and-mermaid-pane-design.md at 7547fe9e (design DEC-221), read by ref. ACs 1-6 are the study's six criteria, lightly condensed. Added by the design (Risks): a bodyRows height check beside the width check. Out of scope, floor/other-repo: version bump to 0.2.0, tag, marketplace pin move, CI workflow edits, the drift note in plain-english-styles' README.

EVIDENCE 2026-10-20. Build: hooks/register.tsx (pane, /diagram, show_diagram), types/index.d.ts, renderer/ copied byte-identically from plain-english-styles d2abfe3a16cd490b1ea3c259512ff7475ef76600 (renderer tree b7ff0dc707371b5a6c894a652c817fcbaaa119d6 equal on both sides, elkjs sha256 20dd2114...), RENDERER-PROVENANCE.md, plugin.json license MIT AND EPL-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause plus types, README fixes. Checks run locally: claude plugin validate passes (one advisory icon warning); tsc -p with the engine types exits 0; claude plugin test: 18 pass, 0 fail (hooks/register.test.tsx, one block per AC, process.run answered by a counting stub); the repo's own gates: mermaid-check 14/14, diagram_lint 0 errors, diagram_truth 0 errors, pytest 44 passed, mermaid_selftest OK, lore check 0 errors under the CI lore 0.12.0 and quest 0.12.0 pair. AC6 real load: a headless claude -p session (model pinned claude-sonnet-5-5, claude 2.1.305) with --plugin-dir reports slash command diagram and tool mcp__diagram-skills__show_diagram in its init event. MUTATION CHECK (mutate the mod, predict the red tests, 7 mutants, tests restored to 18 pass): width check removed -> 2 red (decide, AC2 wide); height check removed -> 2 red (decide, AC2 tall); runtime choice not remembered -> 1 red (AC4); non-mermaid refusal removed -> 1 red (AC3); empty-drawing guard removed -> 1 red (AC3); fence cap 8->20 -> 1 red (AC5); result cache disabled -> 7 red, MORE than the 1 predicted (AC5 only), because the cache is also how a finished render reaches the pane, so every drawing test depends on it. FINDING: the bundled helper is lenient. For some malformed sources (an unclosed flowchart edge, a sequenceDiagram with a dangling arrow) it returns ok:true with an empty or partial drawing, and it reports every header it does not know (pie, mindmap and others) as unsupported-type. So AC3 needed two checks in the mod: a Mermaid-header check and an empty-drawing guard. A partial drawing (an unclosed flowchart draws one node) cannot be told from a complete one without the parse gate in skills/diagram-review; recorded in the README. NOT DONE, floor or other repo: version bump to 0.2.0, tag and release, the opum-marketplace pin move, adding claude plugin validate and the mod test to the CI diagrams job (a workflow edit), the drift note in plain-english-styles' README. For the pin move: opum-marketplace's baseline for diagram-skills records only the skills/ subtree, so a re-pointed tag could change hooks/ and renderer/ with check-federated-content staying green; the v0.2.0 move should record those subtrees too.

SCOPE OF THE PROOF for AC4 and AC5: both are proven with the engine's process.run event answered by a stub (bun and node probes throw; helper calls counted), not with a real PATH stripped of bun and node, and not with a live pane on a real terminal; the kit does not exercise a surface's paint. AC1 draws are asserted on the element type per surface (Text art on terminal, Svg on desktop), as the design's AC1 asks.
finalSummary: DSKI-18 built under ODOC-494 (design DEC-221) and ODOC-497. The diagram pane mod: /diagram <path> and mcp__diagram-skills__show_diagram draw Mermaid as Unicode art on the terminal and Svg on desktop, vscode and mobile, with an HTML fallback (source, one-line reason, Open diagram button writing a network-free page). Renderer copied byte-identically from plain-english-styles d2abfe3a (provenance in RENDERER-PROVENANCE.md), plugin licence MIT AND EPL-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause. 6 of 6 ACs met; 18 plugin tests pass and a 7-mutant check went red as predicted except one superset (cache); plugin validate, tsc and the repo's own gates pass; a real claude -p load lists the command and the tool. Out of scope and not done: the 0.2.0 release, tag, marketplace pin move (the baseline should also record hooks/ and renderer/ subtrees) and the CI workflow additions, all DEC-182 floor work.
